elections.title: 2026 Global Tech & Innovation Council Election
elections.description: Electing the Chief Technology Commissioner for Digital Rights, AI Safety & Next-Gen Infrastructure.

candidates.name: Dr. Aris Vance
candidates.tagline: Pioneering Open AI Governance & Post-Quantum Security.
candidates.bio: Former Director of Distributed Systems at CERN. Author of the Open Source Civic Infrastructure Charter with 18 years in computational cryptography.
agenda: Mandatory Open Source standards for public algorithms

candidates.name: Elena Rostova
candidates.bio: Environmental systems engineer and founder of the Carbon-Neutral Compute Initiative. 15 years advising national energy and smart grid councils.
agenda: 100% Clean Energy mandate for public AI data centers
Algorithmic bias auditing & public impact reports
Equitable green technology grants for schools

candidates.name: Marcus Sterling
candidates.tagline: Decentralized Finance & Worker Protection in the AI Era.
candidates.bio: Senior Economic Policy Analyst and former FinTech Regulatory Commissioner. Architect of universal digital worker dividend proposals.
agenda: Automation transition dividend fund for displaced labor
Stricter anti-monopoly enforcement on big tech

candidates.name: Dr. Amara Okafor
candidates.bio: Pioneer in low-latency mesh networks for underserved schools and founder of the Global Youth Coding Initiative, impacting 2M+ students.
agenda: Universal high-speed civic fiber & satellite access
Open-source STEM curriculum for global K-12
Public civic innovation laboratories in every city
